entries.title: Psalms 115:1
segments: ¶Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy loving-kindness and for thy truth's sake.

entries.title: Psalms 115:2
segments: Wherefore should the nations say, Where then is their God?

entries.title: Psalms 115:3
segments: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he pleased.

entries.title: Psalms 115:4
segments: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands:

entries.title: Psalms 115:5
segments: They have a mouth, and they speak not; eyes have they, and they see not;

entries.title: Psalms 115:6
segments: They have ears, and they hear not; a nose have they, and they smell not;

entries.title: Psalms 115:7
segments: They have hands, and they handle not; feet have they, and they walk not; they give no sound through their throat.

entries.title: Psalms 115:8
segments: They that make them are like unto them, --every one that confideth in them.

entries.title: Psalms 115:9
segments: ¶O Israel, confide thou in Jehovah: he is their help and their shield.

entries.title: Psalms 115:10
segments: House of Aaron, confide in Jehovah: he is their help and their shield.

entries.title: Psalms 115:11
segments: Ye that fear Jehovah, confide in Jehovah: he is their help and their shield.

entries.title: Psalms 115:12
segments: Jehovah hath been mindful of us: he will bless, he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron;

entries.title: Psalms 115:13
segments: He will bless them that fear Jehovah, both the small and the great.

entries.title: Psalms 115:14
segments: Jehovah will add unto you more, unto you and unto your children.

entries.title: Psalms 115:15
segments: Ye are blessed of Jehovah, who made the heavens and the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 115:16
segments: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah, but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 115:17
segments: The dead praise not Jah, neither any that go down into silence;

entries.title: Psalms 115:18
segments: But *we* will bless Jah from this time forth and for evermore. Hallelujah!
